title: AcademicApprovalRecordContract
description: Authoritative contract schema governing formal human approval records. Eliminates fragile prompt-based halting by establishing approval as an explicit state (STAGE_AWAITING_APPROVAL) backed by cryptographic artifact and validation hashes.

stage_id.description: Unique identifier of the stage awaiting approval (e.g. 06_hypothesis_1).

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the research project.

artifact_hash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the stage manifest or primary deliverable on disk.

validation_hash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the passing validation report (validation_report.json).

approved_by.description: Identity of the human approving authority (e.g. saber_admin, 124911145).

decision.description: Authoritative decision status. Must be APPROVED to unlock downstream stages.

comments.description: Reviewer comments, supervisor feedback, or approval stipulations.
